unread.description: Target paths you could not read in full (denied, missing, too large). Empty when you read every target.

kind.description: defect = something is wrong and the fix is clear. decision = a legitimate product/design choice with no single right answer; the user must pick.

location.description: Section/heading of the content, or file:line

evidence.description: Exact quote from the content, or file:line of a repo file you actually read, that grounds the finding

proposed_fix.description: Files: a unified diff. Prose: the literal current text, then the literal replacement, each labeled. Never a vague description. For a decision: the options and their consequence.

target_span.description: The exact snippet the fix would replace, copied verbatim from the content (used to detect conflicts between lenses)
